verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a bare-bones ROS-Base install with no GUI tools, a `ros2` command-line suite for working with nodes and topics, and a launch system for coordinating multiple nodes, which together support headless, scriptable operation. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines or automation workflows specifically. Missing for 10: documented CI integration or headless test-runner guidance, examples of non-interactive automation pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: ROS-Base Install (Bare Bones): Communication libraries, message packages, command line tools. No GUI tools.
The main entry point for the tools is the command ros2, which itself has various sub-commands for introspecting and working with nodes, topics, services, and more.
Launch system for coordinating multiple nodes
ros2 topic pub /chatter std_msgs/msg/String "data: Hello world"
